title: Allow faceting on non-scalar attributes (e.g. for refinementList)

comments.body: Thanks for this very clear issue, I think I've heard of similar use cases before, and IIRC it's possible, but I'd have to research exactly how it's done. If meanwhile someone else finds the answer faster than me, that would be nice

You can now use [`transformItems`](https://www.algolia.com/doc/api-reference/widgets/refinement-list/js/#widget-param-transformitems), introduced in [2.10.0](https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/blob/develop/CHANGELOG.md#2100-2018-08-08).

You can read more on how to migrate to this API in [our InstantSearch.js v3 migration guide](https://www.algolia.com/doc/guides/building-search-ui/upgrade-guides/js/#transformdata-is-replaced-by-transformitems).
